markdown_content: ## Overview of Zipper Management in Clo 2025.1 This section introduces the enhanced zipper features in Clo 2025.1, focusing on zipper customization and management within the Object Browser and Property Editor. It covers zipper selection, editing capabilities, and integration with colorways for detailed design control. --- ## Zipper Tab in the Object Browser The new **Zipper Tab** in the Object Browser centralizes zipper management, allowing users to select and edit zippers directly. Key functionalities include: - **Selection**: Users can choose individual zippers from the garment. - **Editing Options**: Adjust zipper settings such as function (e.g., converting a regular zipper to a two-way zipper). - **Component Selection**: Users can select the entire zipper or focus on parts like the slider, polar, teeth, or tape for targeted edits. --- ## Customizing Zipper Components Within the Property Editor, specific zipper components can be modified: - **Material Type**: Change zipper materials (e.g., plastic, metal). - **Polar and Slider**: Adjust the type and color of the polar and slider components. - **Gauge**: Modify the gauge settings to alter zipper dimensions or functionality. - **Color Customization**: - Tape color can be changed independently from the teeth. - Polar colors and other parts can be customized for detailed design needs. This granular control enables precise visual and functional zipper customization. --- ## Saving and Reapplying Zippers Users can **save complete zipper configurations** for reuse: - Create and save a custom zipper setup, including all component settings. - Apply saved zippers to other garments or locations within the same project. - For example, switch a zipper to a two-way variant by selecting a saved two-way zipper and applying it seamlessly. This feature improves workflow efficiency by allowing zipper presets to be reused and adapted quickly. --- ## Zipper Integration with Colorways Zippers are fully integrated with Clo’s **Colorway system**, enabling advanced color management: - Zipper components are broken down into individual parts within the colorway editor. - Users can rename zipper component color swatches for clarity. - Tape, teeth, polar, slider, and other parts can be assigned distinct colors independently. - Adjustments to zipper colors within colorways allow for multiple design variants without manual re-editing. This deep integration supports complex design variations and rapid prototyping. --- ## Workflow Summary and Benefits - Zippers are easily accessible and manageable via the Object Browser’s dedicated tab. - Property Editor enables detailed editing of zipper types, materials, colors, and components. - Saved zipper presets streamline repetitive tasks and consistency across designs. - Colorway integration allows for flexible, component-level color modifications, enhancing design versatility. - Overall, these features provide a faster, more intuitive zipper design experience in Clo 2025.1.
